verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is Skyvern's 'captcha-and-bot-bypass' docs page, which documents automatic vision-based CAPTCHA solving (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile and others). The page's 'bot-bypass' title implies some anti-bot handling, but no quoted content describes stealth fingerprinting or residential/geo-targeted proxies.
